messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release v0.42.1 -> prod-eu. Starting post-deploy verification: synth-kv, prefix-cache-warm, kv-ttl-checks. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v0.42.1 :party_popper:

mira: quick FYI — eu1 synth-kv 95p jumped from ~1.2s to ~2.8s right after warmup started. Observed on 3 hosts.

jason: digging into kernels on node eu1-a3, seeing fallback to generic matmul at 13:02:14, logs show repeated "no optimized kernel" warnings.

sre-ops: canary at 10% so far. Other metrics (error rate, cpu) are stable. Latency spike is only on prefix-heavy synth. Should we pause ramp?

eva: I'd prefer to pause routing for eu region until we confirm. Pin traffic to previous stable v0.41.9 for eu and run targeted warmup. :hand:

mira: agreed. Suggest pin in routing layer (not a full rollback) so control plane still shows v0.42.1 but traffic routed to 0.41.9 for eu. Then run a KV prefix priming job + re-run synth probes. If 95p remains >1.6s after warmup, execute rollback per runbook.

deploy-bot: Applying routing pin: region=eu pinned_version=0.41.9 by mira at 13:05 UTC. Canary traffic -> 0% for v0.42.1 in eu. Notifying alerting.

oncall-bot: Incident created #INC-2112233445: "eu post-deploy synth KV latency spike". Pager duty notified.

jason: capturing relevant logs and core dump snippet, attaching commands to reproduce: ```sudo journalctl -u inference.service --since "13:00" | grep -E "kernel|fallback|error" -n```

mira: starting prefix priming job now: will send ~60k prefix requests across eu cluster to refill KV cache. ETA ~7m.

sre-ops: ack. If priming doesn't bring 95p under 1.6s within 10m, proceed with full rollback window (rolling back prod-eu to v0.41.9) and open a postmortem.

eva: added rollback plan + checklist to the incident doc. Also noted: watch for KV TTL churn after priming (may cause transient spikes).

deploy-bot: Priming job completed at 13:12 UTC. Synth probe run started.

mira: synth probe after priming: 95p=1.4s, 99p=1.9s, error rate 0.03%. Looks within acceptable bounds.

sre-ops: nice — recommended to hold canary paused for another 5m and then ramp to 30% if stable.

ejason: leaving a note: kernel fallback logs show a race where quantized kernel lookup failed under high prefix variety. I'll file a patch for a safe fallback path; tracking in #eng-ml.

eva: confirmed. I'll update release notes with the mitigation and call it out in the changelog.

mira: resuming controlled ramp: bumping v0.42.1 -> 30% in eu now, will watch 1m windows.

deploy-bot: Canary ramped to 30% at 13:21 UTC. Will post a final status in 10m. :rocket:

(End of thread)
